title_sq: Apartament 2+1 per shitje- Kika 2, Komuna e Parisit
description_sq:
Apartamenti ndodhet ne nje nga godinat e kompleksit Kika 2, Komuna e Parisit.
Me siperfaqe 84 m2 prona eshte e strukturuar ne: Korridor shperndares, tualet, 2 dhoma gjumi, ambient gatimi dhe ndenje, ballkon.
-Ofron hapesire te miremenaxhuar per nje jetese komode familjare.
-Ambient i ngrohte dhe praktik
-Arredim bashkekohor, i menduar per te maksimizuar cdo hapesire
-Ballkon me pamje te lire
-Akses i lehte si nga rruga edhe nga parkimi
-Godine e mirembajtur, me 2 ashensore
Zgjedhje ideale per ata qe kerkojne kombinim te vendndodhjes strategjike, funksionalitetit dhe komoditetit.
Apartamenti mund te blihet me kredi.
Per me teper detaje apo nje vizite ne prone, na kontaktoni.
title_en: 2+1 apartment for sale - Kika 2, Municipality of Paris
description_en: The apartment is located in one of the buildings of the Kika 2 complex, Paris Municipality. With an area of ​​84 m2, the property is structured in: distribution corridor, toilet, 2 bedrooms, kitchen and living room, balcony. - Offers well-managed space for a comfortable family life. -Warm and practical environment -Contemporary furnishing, designed to maximize every space -Balcony with open view -Easy access both from the street and from the parking lot -Well maintained building, with 2 elevators Ideal choice for those looking for a combination of strategic location, functionality and comfort. The apartment can be bought with a loan. For more details or a visit to the property, contact us.
